verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's my.anydesk portal is documented for managing address books and devices and for managing users with roles and permissions, and the REST API lists the address books tied to a license. However, the evidence does not show that address books are shared across admins, or that access policies can be scoped per group of machines or users; it shows only org-level roles and permissions, in one-line help-center summaries. Missing for 10: explicit shared or team address book documentation, per-group access policy scoping, in-depth console docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Learn how to manage address books, monitor sessions, and manage devices using the portal.
Manage users, assign roles and permissions for your organization, and configure custom clients.

The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
